GAMEPLAY_CrowCarcassDescription.English: The carcass of a crow. Can be harvested but... is that really a good idea?
GAMEPLAY_CrowCarcassDescription.Spanish (Spain): El cadáver de un cuervo. Se puede sacar algo de él pero...¿Realmente es una buena idea?.
GAMEPLAY_CrowCarcassDescription.German: Der Kadaver einer Krähe. Kann zerlegt werden... aber ist das wirklich eine gute Idee?
GAMEPLAY_CrowCarcassDescription.Russian: Туша мертвой вороны. Конечно ее можно собрать.... но это хорошая идея?
GAMEPLAY_CrowCarcassDescription.Turkish: Karga leşi. Hasat edilebilir ama... bu gerçekten iyi bir fikir mi bilemem?

GAMEPLAY_BirdMeatRawDescription.English: Meat harvested from a crow. Not precisely a four course meal, and not very pleasant, but it's food. Don't eat it raw.
GAMEPLAY_BirdMeatRawDescription.Spanish (Spain): Carne obtenida de un cuervo. No es precisamente un menú de cuatro platos, y no es muy agradable, pero es comida. No te lo comas crudo.
GAMEPLAY_BirdMeatRawDescription.German: Fleisch von einer Krähe. Nicht gerade ein Vier-Gänge-Menü und nicht sehr angenehm, aber es ist Essen. Nicht roh essen.
GAMEPLAY_BirdMeatRawDescription.Russian: Собранное мясо вороны. Это, конечно, еда не высшей кухни, но это еда. Не употреблять сырым.
GAMEPLAY_BirdMeatRawDescription.Turkish: Bir kargadan hasat edilen et. Tam olarak dört kişilik bir yemek değil ve çok hoşta değil, ama bu bir yemek. Çiğ yemeyin.

GAMEPLAY_BirdMeatCookedDescription.English: Meat harvested from a crow. Not precisely a four course meal, and not very pleasant, but it's food. Looks like chicken if you don't think much about it.
GAMEPLAY_BirdMeatCookedDescription.Spanish (Spain): Carne obtenida de un cuervo. No es precisamente un menú de cuatro platos, y no es muy agradable, pero es comida. Parece pollo, si no lo piensas demasaido..
GAMEPLAY_BirdMeatCookedDescription.German: Fleisch von einer Krähe. Nicht gerade ein Vier-Gänge-Menü und nicht sehr angenehm, aber es ist Essen. Sieht aus wie Hühnchen, wenn man nicht viel darüber nachdenkt.
GAMEPLAY_BirdMeatCookedDescription.Russian: Приготовленное мясо вороны. Выглядит как курица, поэтому при поедании думай о курице.
GAMEPLAY_BirdMeatCookedDescription.Turkish: Bir kargadan hasat edilen et. Tam olarak dört kişilik bir yemek değil ve çok hoşta değil, ama bu bir yemek. Fazla düşünmezsen tadı tavuk gibi geliyor.

GAMEPLAY_SaltedFishBassLargeDescription.English: A giant bass, larger than life. Salted to dry it.
GAMEPLAY_SaltedFishBassLargeDescription.Russian: Просоленный большеротый окунь. Готов к просушке.
GAMEPLAY_SaltedFishBassLargeDescription.Spanish (Spain): Una perca gigante, la más grande que jamás hayas visto. Salada para secarse.

GAMEPLAY_CuredFishBassLargeDescription.English: A giant bass, larger than life, dried with salt. Will take longer to go bad.
GAMEPLAY_CuredFishBassLargeDescription.Russian: Просоленный и просушенный большеротый окунь. Может долго хранится.
GAMEPLAY_CuredFishBassLargeDescription.Spanish (Spain): Una perca gigante, la más grande que jamás hayas visto, secada con sal. Tardará más tiempo en ponerse mala.

GAMEPLAY_SaltedFishBassSmallDescription.English: A hefty sized freshwater fish. Intolerant of polluted waters. Salted to dry it.
GAMEPLAY_SaltedFishBassSmallDescription.Russian: Просоленный малоротый окунь. Крупная рыба, обитающая в пресноводный водоемах. Готов к просушке.
GAMEPLAY_SaltedFishBassSmallDescription.Spanish (Spain): Un pescado de agua dulce de un tamaño considerable. No sobrevive en aguas contaminadas. Salado para secarse.

GAMEPLAY_CuredFishBassSmallDescription.English: A hefty sized freshwater fish, that is intolerant of polluted waters, dried with salt. Will take longer to go bad.
GAMEPLAY_CuredFishBassSmallDescription.Russian: Просоленный и просушенный молоротый окунь. Может долго хранится.
GAMEPLAY_CuredFishBassSmallDescription.Spanish (Spain): Un pescado de agua dulce de un tamaño considerable, el cual no sobrevive en aguas contaminadas, secado con sal. Tardará más tiempo en ponerse malo.

GAMEPLAY_SaltedFishBurbotDescription.English: A bottom-dwelling freshwater fish. Can grow to impressive size. Salted to dry it.
GAMEPLAY_SaltedFishBurbotDescription.Russian: Просоленный налим. Необычная усатая и большая рыба, живущая в пресных водоемах. Готов к просушке.
GAMEPLAY_SaltedFishBurbotDescription.Spanish (Spain): Un pez de fondo de agua dulce. Puede llegar alcanzar un tamaño considerable. Salado para secarse.

GAMEPLAY_CuredFishBurbotDescription.English: A bottom-dwelling freshwater fish that can grow to impressive size, dried with salt. Will take longer to go bad.
GAMEPLAY_CuredFishBurbotDescription.Russian: Просоленный и просушенный налим. Может долго храниться.
GAMEPLAY_CuredFishBurbotDescription.Spanish (Spain): Un pez de fondo de agua dulce, que puede llegar alcanzar un tamaño considerable, secado con sal. Tardará más tiempo en ponerse malo.

GAMEPLAY_SaltedFishGoldeyeDescription.English: A small freshwater fish. Will eat almost anything it can swallow. Salted to dry it.
GAMEPLAY_SaltedFishGoldeyeDescription.Russian: Просоленная золотоглазка. Маленькая пресноводная рыба. Готова к просушке.
GAMEPLAY_SaltedFishGoldeyeDescription.Spanish (Spain): Un pez de agua dulce más bien pequeño. Come casi cualquier cosa que pueda llevarse a la boca. Salado para secarse.

GAMEPLAY_CuredFishGoldeyeDescription.English: A small freshwater fish, that will eat almost anything it can swallow, dried with salt. Will take longer to go bad.
GAMEPLAY_CuredFishGoldeyeDescription.Russian: Просоленная и просушенная золотоглазка. Может долго храниться.
GAMEPLAY_CuredFishGoldeyeDescription.Spanish (Spain): Un pez de agua dulce más bien pequeño, que come casi cualquier cosa que pueda llevarse a la boca, secado con sal. Tardará más tiempo en ponerse malo.

GAMEPLAY_SaltedFishRedDescription.English: A saltwater fish. Carnivorous and colourful. Salted to dry it.
GAMEPLAY_SaltedFishRedDescription.Russian: Просоленный красный ирландский лорд. Хищная с яркой чешуей. Готов к просушке
GAMEPLAY_SaltedFishRedDescription.Spanish (Spain): Un pez de agua salada. Tiene escamas de un intenso color rojo y es carnívoro. Salado para secarse.

GAMEPLAY_CuredFishRedDescription.English: A saltwater fish, that is carnivorous and colourful, dried with salt. Will take longer to go bad.
GAMEPLAY_CuredFishRedDescription.Russian: Просоленный и просушенный красный ирландский лорд. Может долго храниться.
GAMEPLAY_CuredFishRedDescription.Spanish (Spain): Un pez de agua salada, que tiene escamas de un intenso color rojo y es carnívoro, secado con sal. Tardará más tiempo en ponerse malo.

GAMEPLAY_SaltedFishRockDescription.English: A saltwater fish. Spiny, but edible. Salted to dry it.
GAMEPLAY_SaltedFishRockDescription.Russian: Просоленный морской окунь. Колючая, но съедобная. Готов к просушке.
GAMEPLAY_SaltedFishRockDescription.Spanish (Spain): Un pez de agua salada. Tiene muchas espinas, pero es comestible. Salado para secarse.

GAMEPLAY_CuredFishRockDescription.English: A saltwater fish, that is spiny but edible, dried with salt. Will take longer to go bad.
GAMEPLAY_CuredFishRockDescription.Russian: Просоленый и просушенный морской окунь. Мождет долго храниться.
GAMEPLAY_CuredFishRockDescription.Spanish (Spain): Un pez de agua salada, que tiene muchas espinas pero es comestible, secado con sal. Tardará más tiempo en ponerse malo.

GAMEPLAY_SaltedFishSalmonDescription.English: A formidable West Coast fish. Grows to a good size. Salted to dry it.
GAMEPLAY_SaltedFishSalmonDescription.Russian: Просоленный кижуч. Большая морская рыба. Готов к просушке
GAMEPLAY_SaltedFishSalmonDescription.Spanish (Spain): Un magnífico pescado de la costa oeste de Norteamérica. Puede alcanzar un gran tamaño. Salado para secarse.

GAMEPLAY_CuredFishSalmonDescription.English: A formidable West Coast fish, that grows to a good size, dried with salt. Will take longer to go bad.
GAMEPLAY_CuredFishSalmonDescription.Russian: Просоленный и просушенный кижуч. Может долго храниться.
GAMEPLAY_CuredFishSalmonDescription.Spanish (Spain): Un magnífico pescado de la costa oeste de Norteamérica, que puede alcanzar un gran tamaño, secado con sal. Tardará más tiempo en ponerse malo.

GAMEPLAY_SaltedFishTroutDescription.English: A small saltwater fish, named for its irridescence. Salted to dry it.
GAMEPLAY_SaltedFishTroutDescription.Russian: Просоленная радужная форель. Маленькая морская рыба с переливчатой чешуей. Готова к просушке.
GAMEPLAY_SaltedFishTroutDescription.Spanish (Spain): Un pequeño pescado de agua salada. Su nombre se debe a su iridiscencia. Salado para secarse.

GAMEPLAY_CuredFishTroutDescription.English: A small saltwater fish, named for its irridescence, dried with salt. Will take longer to go bad.
GAMEPLAY_CuredFishTroutDescription.Russian: Просоленная и просушенная радужная форель. Может долго храниться.
GAMEPLAY_CuredFishTroutDescription.Spanish (Spain): Un pequeño pescado de agua salada, cuyo nombre se debe a su iridiscencia, secado con sal. Tardará más tiempo en ponerse malo.

GAMEPLAY_SaltedFishWhiteDescription.English: A common freshwater fish. Small, but plentiful. Salted to dry it.
GAMEPLAY_SaltedFishWhiteDescription.Russian: Просоленный сиг. Пресноводная рыба. Маленькая и калорийная. Готов к просушке.
GAMEPLAY_SaltedFishWhiteDescription.Spanish (Spain): Un pescado común de agua dulce. Es pequeño, pero llena bastante. Salado para secarse.

GAMEPLAY_CuredFishWhiteDescription.English: A common freshwater fish, that is small but plentiful, dried with salt. Will take longer to go bad.
GAMEPLAY_CuredFishWhiteDescription.Russian: Просоленный и просушенный сиг. Может долго храниться.
GAMEPLAY_CuredFishWhiteDescription.Spanish (Spain): Un pescado común de agua dulce, el cual es pequeño pero llena bastante, secado con sal. Tardará más tiempo en ponerse malo.

GAMEPLAY_SaltedMeatBirdDescription.Spanish (Spain): Carne obtenida de un cuervo, salada para secarse.
GAMEPLAY_SaltedMeatBirdDescription.German: Fleisch von einer Krähe, gesalzen um zu trocknen.
GAMEPLAY_SaltedMeatBirdDescription.Russian: Просоленное мясо вороны. Готово к просушке.
GAMEPLAY_SaltedMeatBirdDescription.Turkish: Bir kargadan hasat edilen et. Tuzlanmış ve bir süre dinlendirilmiş

GAMEPLAY_CuredMeatBirdDescription.English: Meat harvested from a crow, dried with salt. Will take longer to go bad.
GAMEPLAY_CuredMeatBirdDescription.Spanish (Spain): Carne obtenida de un cuervo, secada con sal. Tardará más tiempo en ponerse mala.

GAMEPLAY_CuredMeatBirdDescription.Turkish: Bir kargadan hasat edilen et. Tuzda bekletilmiş. Bozulması uzun zaman alır.

GAMEPLAY_BirdFeatherBundleDescription.English: A bundle of feathers harvested from a crow.
GAMEPLAY_BirdFeatherBundleDescription.Spanish (Spain): Un grupo de plumas obtenidas de un cuervo.
GAMEPLAY_BirdFeatherBundleDescription.German: Ein Bündel Federn von einer Krähe.
GAMEPLAY_BirdFeatherBundleDescription.Russian: Потрепанное крыло вороны, но на нем все равно есть несколько хороших перьев.

GAMEPLAY_BirdEggRawDescription.English: The egg of an unidentified bird. Probably, it won't hatch. Don't eat it raw.
GAMEPLAY_BirdEggRawDescription.Spanish (Spain): Huevo de un ave sin identificar. Probablemente nunca eclosione. No te lo comas crudo.
GAMEPLAY_BirdEggRawDescription.German: Das Ei eines unbekannten Vogels. Vielleicht wird es nicht schlüpfen. Nicht roh essen.
GAMEPLAY_BirdEggRawDescription.Russian: Яйцо неизвестной птицы. Птенец скорее всего уже мертв. Не употреблять в сыром виде.
GAMEPLAY_BirdEggRawDescription.Turkish: Kimliği belirsiz bir kuşun yumurtası. Muhtemelen yumurtadan çıkmayacak. Çiğ yemeyin.

GAMEPLAY_BirdEggBoiledDescription.English: The egg of an unidentified bird. Boiled and ready to eat.
GAMEPLAY_BirdEggBoiledDescription.Spanish (Spain): Huevo de un ave sin identificar. Cocido y listo para comer.
GAMEPLAY_BirdEggBoiledDescription.German: Das Ei eines unbekannten Vogels. Gekocht und fertig zum Essen.
GAMEPLAY_BirdEggBoiledDescription.Russian: Яйцо птицы. Сваренное до идеального состояния, готово к употреблению.
GAMEPLAY_BirdEggBoiledDescription.Turkish: Kimliği belirsiz bir kuşun yumurtası. Haşlanmış ve yemeye hazır.

GAMEPLAY_OrcaQuarterDescription.English: Meat lump from an orca carcass.
GAMEPLAY_OrcaQuarterDescription.Spanish (Spain): Trozo de carne proveniente del cadáver de una orca.
GAMEPLAY_OrcaQuarterDescription.Russian: Часть туши касатки. Ее легко переносить. Можно собрать мясо касатки

GAMEPLAY_OrcaFatDescription.English: Lump of blubber harvested from an orca carcass. It's oily and stinks a lot. You could find some use to it.
GAMEPLAY_OrcaFatDescription.Spanish (Spain): Trozo de grasa proveniente del cadáver de una orca. Está aceitoso y apesta una barbaridad. Quizás puedas encontrarle algún uso.
GAMEPLAY_OrcaFatDescription.German: Speckklumpen eines Orcakadavers. Es ist ölig und stinkt sehr. Vielleicht findest du dafür einen Nutzen.
GAMEPLAY_OrcaFatDescription.Russian: Добытый из касатки жир. Он маслянистый и жутко воняет. Возможно стоит его переработать на масло.
GAMEPLAY_OrcaFatDescription.Turkish: Bir katil balina leşinden hasat edilmiş balina yağı parçası. Yağlı ve çok kokuyor. Biraz faydasını görebilirsin.

GAMEPLAY_FuelOrcaDescription.English: Oil obtained from blubber. Refuel your lamp with this.
GAMEPLAY_FuelOrcaDescription.Spanish (Spain): Aceite obtenido de la grasa de una ballena. Rellena tu lámpara con esto.
GAMEPLAY_FuelOrcaDescription.German: Aus Speck gewonnenes Öl. Befüllen Sie damit Ihre Laterne.
GAMEPLAY_FuelOrcaDescription.Russian: Масло из жира касатки, подходит только для использования в фонарях.
GAMEPLAY_FuelOrcaDescription.Turkish: Katil Balina yağından elde edilen sıvı yağ. Lambanızı bununla doldurun.

GAMEPLAY_OrcaMeatRawDescription.English: Meat harvested from an orca carcass. A bit greasy to the touch. You heard somewhere people have eaten whales before.
GAMEPLAY_OrcaMeatRawDescription.Spanish (Spain): Carne proveniente del cadáver de una orca. Un poco grasienta al tacto. Jurarías haber escuchado que la gente ha comido ballenas alguna vez.
GAMEPLAY_OrcaMeatRawDescription.German: Fleisch von einem Orcakadaver. Fühlt sich etwas fettig an. Dass Menschen schon einmal Wale gegessen haben, hast du schon gehört.
GAMEPLAY_OrcaMeatRawDescription.Russian: Мясо из туши касатки. На ощупь жирное. Вы слышали, что раньше люди ели касаток.
GAMEPLAY_OrcaMeatRawDescription.Turkish: Bir katil balina ölüsünden hasat edilen et. Dokunmak için biraz yağlı. Daha önce bir yerde insanların balina yediğini duymuşsunuzdur.

GAMEPLAY_OrcaMeatCookedDescription.English: Meat from an orca. A bit greasy to the touch. Doesn't look half bad.
GAMEPLAY_OrcaMeatCookedDescription.Spanish (Spain): Carne proveniente de una orca. Un poco grasienta al tacto. No tiene mala pinta.
GAMEPLAY_OrcaMeatCookedDescription.German: Fleisch eines Orcas. Fühlt sich etwas fettig an. Sieht gar nicht so schlecht aus.
GAMEPLAY_OrcaMeatCookedDescription.Russian: Мясо касатки. Все так же жирное, но выглядит не так уж и плохо.
GAMEPLAY_OrcaMeatCookedDescription.Turkish: Katil Balina eti. Dokunmak için biraz yağlı. Yarı kötü görünmüyor.

GAMEPLAY_SaltedMeatOrcaDescription.English: Meat harvested from an orca, salted to dry it.
GAMEPLAY_SaltedMeatOrcaDescription.Spanish (Spain): Carne obtenida de una orca, salada para secarse.
GAMEPLAY_SaltedMeatOrcaDescription.German: Fleisch von einem Orca, gesalzen um zu trocknen.
GAMEPLAY_SaltedMeatOrcaDescription.Russian: Просоленное мясо касатки. Готово к просушке.
GAMEPLAY_SaltedMeatOrcaDescription.Turkish: Katil Balinadan hasat edilen et. Tuzlanmış ve bir süre bekletilmiş.

GAMEPLAY_CuredMeatOrcaDescription.English: Meat harvested from an orca, dried with salt. Will take longer to go bad.
GAMEPLAY_CuredMeatOrcaDescription.Spanish (Spain): Carne obtenida de una orca, secada con sal. Tardará más tiempo en ponerse mala.
GAMEPLAY_CuredMeatOrcaDescription.German: Fleisch von einem Orca, mit Salz getrocknet. Verdirbt nicht so schnell.
GAMEPLAY_CuredMeatOrcaDescription.Russian: Просоленное и просушенное мясо касатки. Может храниться долго, но из-за такого приготовления все еще содержит паразитов.
GAMEPLAY_CuredMeatOrcaDescription.Turkish: Katil Balinadan hasat edilen et. Tuzda bekletilmiş. Bozulması uzun zaman alır.

GAMEPLAY_BeeHiveDescription.English: A frozen bee hive, a rare sight these days. Maybe you could still get something of use out of it. Looks abandoned, and bees won't come back any time soon.
GAMEPLAY_BeeHiveDescription.Spanish (Spain): Una colmena de abejas congelada, algo dificil de ver estos días. Quizás aún le puedas sacar algo de valor. Parece abandonado, y no parece que las abejas vayan a volver pronto.
GAMEPLAY_BeeHiveDescription.German: Ein gefrorener Bienenstock, heutzutage ein seltener Anblick. Vielleicht kann man etwas Brauchbares daraus machen. Sieht verlassen aus und die Bienen werden wohl nicht so schnell zurückkommen.
GAMEPLAY_BeeHiveDescription.Russian: Замерзший улей, редкое явления в наши дни. Выглядит полезным, возможно из него получиться что-то добыть. Выглядит заброшенным и пчелы не скоро в него вернутся.
GAMEPLAY_BeeHiveDescription.Turkish: Donmuş bir arı kovanı, bugünlerde nadir görülen bir manzara. Belki yine de ondan işe yarar bir şeyler alabilirsin. Terk edilmiş görünüyor ve arılar yakın zamanda geri gelmeyecek.

GAMEPLAY_BeeHarvestedHoneyDescription.English: Natural honey, extracted from a bee hive. Sweet and full of energy.
GAMEPLAY_BeeHarvestedHoneyDescription.Spanish (Spain): Miel natural, extraida de una colmena de abejas. Dulce y llena de energía.
GAMEPLAY_BeeHarvestedHoneyDescription.German: Natürlicher Honig, aus einem Bienenstock extrahiert. Süß und voller Energie.
GAMEPLAY_BeeHarvestedHoneyDescription.Russian: Натуральный мед, добытый из пчелиного улья. Такой сладкий и калорийный.
GAMEPLAY_BeeHarvestedHoneyDescription.Turkish: Arı Kovanından çıkarılmış doğal bal. Tatlı ve bol enerjili

GAMEPLAY_CookedOmeletteDescription.English: Made out of the eggs of an unidentified bird. It really looks tastier this way.
GAMEPLAY_CookedOmeletteDescription.Russian: Простой омлет, сделанный из пару яиц. Многие считают его отличным завтраком.
GAMEPLAY_CookedOmeletteDescription.Spanish (Spain): Hecha con los huevos de un ave sin identificar. Parece más apetecible así.

GAMEPLAY_CookedForagerOmeletteDescriptio.English: Made out of the eggs of an unidentified bird, with some fir seeds to spice it up. It really looks tastier this way.
GAMEPLAY_CookedForagerOmeletteDescriptio.Russian: Омлет с начинкой в виде орехов. Сытный завтрак.
GAMEPLAY_CookedForagerOmeletteDescriptio.Spanish (Spain): Hecha con los huevos de un ave sin identificar, con algunos piñones para darle un toque especial. Parece más apetecible así.

GAMEPLAY_CookedSpanishOmeletteDescriptio.English: Made out of the eggs of an unidentified bird and potatoes. Hard to master, but very tasty. Feels like it's missing something...
GAMEPLAY_CookedSpanishOmeletteDescriptio.Russian: Простой пирог из картофеля и яиц. Приготовить его трудно, но оно того стоит. Но есть ощущение, что чего то не хватает... (мяса?)
GAMEPLAY_CookedSpanishOmeletteDescriptio.Spanish (Spain): Hecha con los huevos de un ave sin identificar y patatas. Dificil de dominar pero muy sabrosa. Parece que le falta algo...

GAMEPLAY_UncookedOmeletteDescription.English: Beaten eggs of an unidentified bird, perfect to make omelette. Don't drink it.
GAMEPLAY_UncookedOmeletteDescription.Spanish (Spain): Huevos batidos de un ave sin identificar, perfecto para una tortilla. No te lo bebas.

GAMEPLAY_CookedForagerStewDescription.English: Made with orca, vegetables and fir seeds. May not sound that good, but you won't find better stew.
GAMEPLAY_CookedForagerStewDescription.Russian: Необычное рагу из мяса касатки, овощей и орехов. Такого раньше вы не ели, но все же бывает в первый раз.
GAMEPLAY_CookedForagerStewDescription.Spanish (Spain): Hecho con orca, vegetales y piñones. Puede que no suene muy bien, pero no vas a encontrar mejor estofado.

GAMEPLAY_NestEmptyDescription.English: The nest from an unidentified bird, completely abandoned. A good source of sticks.
GAMEPLAY_NestEmptyDescription.Spanish (Spain): Un nido de un pajaro sin identificar, completamente abandonado. Una buena fuente de palos.
GAMEPLAY_NestEmptyDescription.German: Das Nest eines unbekannten Vogels, komplett verlassen. Eine gute Quelle für Stöcke.
GAMEPLAY_NestEmptyDescription.Russian: Гнездо неизвестной птицы, к сожалению пустое. Можно разобрать на палки.
GAMEPLAY_NestEmptyDescription.Turkish: Tanımlanamayan bir kuşun yuvası tamamen terk edilmiş. İyi bir çubuk kaynağı.

GAMEPLAY_NestFullDescription.English: The nest from an unidentified bird, with some eggs inside. A good source of food and sticks.
GAMEPLAY_NestFullDescription.Russian: Гнездо неизвестной птицы с яйцами внутри. Отлично и еда, и палки.
GAMEPLAY_NestFullDescription.Spanish (Spain): Un nido de un pajaro sin identificar, con algunos huevos dentro. Una buena fuente de comida y palos.

GAMEPLAY_4FirConeDescription.English: A cone from a fir tree, full of edible seeds.
GAMEPLAY_4FirConeDescription.Spanish (Spain): Piña de abeto llena de semillas comestibles.
GAMEPLAY_4FirConeDescription.German: Ein Zapfen eines Tannenbaumes, voll mit essbaren Samen.
GAMEPLAY_4FirConeDescription.Russian: Упавшая шишка с дерева. Внутри полно орехов.
GAMEPLAY_4FirConeDescription.Turkish: Yenilebilir tohumlarla dolu bir köknar ağacından bir kozalak.

GAMEPLAY_1FirConeFuelDescription.English: A cone from a fir tree, whose seeds have been removed. Can be used to fuel a fire.
GAMEPLAY_1FirConeFuelDescription.Spanish (Spain): Piña de abeto a la que se le han extraido las semillas. Puede usarse como combustible para fogatas.
GAMEPLAY_1FirConeFuelDescription.German: Ein Zapfen eines Tannenbaumes, dessen Samen entfernt wurden. Kann als nützlicher Brennstoff verwendet werden.
GAMEPLAY_1FirConeFuelDescription.Russian: Упавшая шишка с дерева, все орехи собраны. Можно сжечь в костре.
GAMEPLAY_1FirConeFuelDescription.Turkish: Tohumları çıkarılmış bir köknar ağacının kozalağı. Ateş yakmak için kullanılabilir.

GAMEPLAY_3FirConeSeedsDescription.English: The seeds of a fir tree. Can be roasted to make a light snack.
GAMEPLAY_3FirConeSeedsDescription.Spanish (Spain): Piñones procedentes de un abeto. Se pueden asar y comer como aperitivo.
GAMEPLAY_3FirConeSeedsDescription.German: Die Samen eines Tannenbaumes. Können für einen leichten Snack geröstet werden.
GAMEPLAY_3FirConeSeedsDescription.Russian: Собранные орехи из шишки. Обжарить и можно съесть.
GAMEPLAY_3FirConeSeedsDescription.Turkish: Köknar ağacının tohumları. Hafif bir atıştırmalık yapmak için kavrulabilir.

GAMEPLAY_2FirSeedBunchDescription.English: The seeds of a fir tree. Can be roasted to make a light snack.
GAMEPLAY_2FirSeedBunchDescription.Spanish (Spain): Piñones procedentes de un abeto. Se pueden asar y comer como aperitivo.
GAMEPLAY_2FirSeedBunchDescription.German: Die Samen eines Tannenbaumes. Können für einen leichten Snack geröstet werden.
GAMEPLAY_2FirSeedBunchDescription.Russian: Небольшая кучка орехов. Обжарить и можно съесть.
GAMEPLAY_2FirSeedBunchDescription.Turkish: Köknar ağacının tohumları. Hafif bir atıştırmalık yapmak için kavrulabilir.

GAMEPLAY_2FirConeSeedsRoastedDescription.English: The seeds of a fir tree. Roasted and ready to eat.
GAMEPLAY_2FirConeSeedsRoastedDescription.Spanish (Spain): Piñones procedentes de un abeto. Asadas y listas para comer.
GAMEPLAY_2FirConeSeedsRoastedDescription.German: Die Samen eines Tannenbaumes. Geröstet und fertig zum Essen.
GAMEPLAY_2FirConeSeedsRoastedDescription.Russian: Обжаренные орехи. Источают приятный запах. Небольшой перекус.
GAMEPLAY_2FirConeSeedsRoastedDescription.Turkish: Köknar ağacının tohumları. Kavrulmuş ve yenmeye hazır hale getirilmiş.

GAMEPLAY_1FirSeedBunchRoastedDescription.English: The seeds of a fir tree. Roasted and ready to eat.
GAMEPLAY_1FirSeedBunchRoastedDescription.Spanish (Spain): Piñones procedentes de un abeto. Asadas y listas para comer.
GAMEPLAY_1FirSeedBunchRoastedDescription.German: Die Samen eines Tannenbaumes. Geröstet und fertig zum Essen.
GAMEPLAY_1FirSeedBunchRoastedDescription.Russian: Небольшая кучка обжаренных орехов. Источают приятный запах. Небольшой перекус.
GAMEPLAY_1FirSeedBunchRoastedDescription.Turkish: Köknar ağacının tohumları. Kavrulmuş ve yenmeye hazır hale getirilmiş

GAMEPLAY_HaliteDescription.English: Salt rock, mined across Great Bear.
GAMEPLAY_HaliteDescription.Spanish (Spain): Roca de sal, minada por toda Gran Oso.
GAMEPLAY_HaliteDescription.Russian: Природный минерал, известен как каменная, горная или поваренная соль. Формируеться на всем острове Великого Медведя.
GAMEPLAY_HaliteDescription.Turkish: Great Bear madeninden çıkarılan Kaya tuzu.

GAMEPLAY_HaliteSmallDescription.English: Salt rock, mined across Great Bear.
GAMEPLAY_HaliteSmallDescription.Spanish (Spain): Roca de sal, minada por toda Gran Oso.
GAMEPLAY_HaliteSmallDescription.Russian: Природный минерал, известен как каменная, горная или поваренная соль. Формируеться на всем острове Великого Медведя.
GAMEPLAY_HaliteSmallDescription.Turkish: Great Bear madeninden çıkarılan Kaya tuzu.

GAMEPLAY_CoalChunkDescription.English: A coal formation. Break it in smaller pieces to use them.
GAMEPLAY_CoalChunkDescription.Spanish (Spain): Formación de carbón. Rómpela en pedazos más pequeños pata poder usarlos.
GAMEPLAY_CoalChunkDescription.German: Ein Brocken Kohle. Zum Benutzen in kleine Stücke brechen.
GAMEPLAY_CoalChunkDescription.Russian: Сформировавшийся кусок угля. Для его использования лучше раздробить на более мелкие куски.
GAMEPLAY_CoalChunkDescription.Turkish: Bir kömür oluşumu. Kullanmak için daha küçük parçalara ayırın.

GAMEPLAY_CrushedHaliteDescription.English: Crushed salt rock. Can be used for cooking.
GAMEPLAY_CrushedHaliteDescription.Spanish (Spain): Roca de sal machacada. Puede usarse para cocinar.
GAMEPLAY_CrushedHaliteDescription.German: Zerstoßener Salzstein. Kann zum Kochen verwendet werden.
GAMEPLAY_CrushedHaliteDescription.Russian: Размельченный на гранулы галит. Теперь может быть использован в готовке.
GAMEPLAY_CrushedHaliteDescription.Turkish: Ezilmiş Kaya Tuzu. Yemek yapmak için kullanılabilir.

GAMEPLAY_SkullStagDescription.Spanish (Spain): La calavera de un ciervo muerto.
GAMEPLAY_SkullStagDescription.Russian: Череп неизвестного оленя. Судя по виду лежит он тут давно.

GAMEPLAY_SkullBearDescription.Spanish (Spain): La calavera de un oso muerto.
GAMEPLAY_SkullBearDescription.Russian: Череп неизвестного медведя. Судя по виду лежит он тут давно.

GAMEPLAY_CryptidHeadWearDescription.English: A headwear, made out of bones, some pelt and a stag skull. Will warm your ears and neck, but your face? not so much. The strange aura of the skull seem to scare wolves.
GAMEPLAY_CryptidHeadWearDescription.Russian: Необычная маска, сделанная из костей, шкуры и черепа. Напоминает вам картинки из книги о Лешем. Эта маска поможет вам согреть голову, и кажеться обладает странной аурой, которая отпугивает волков.
GAMEPLAY_CryptidHeadWearDescription.Spanish (Spain): Un tocado, hecho con huesos, algo de pelaje y la calavera de un ciervo. Te calentará las orejas y el cuello ¿Pero la cara? no demasiado. La extraña aura de la clavera parece auyentar a los lobos.

GAMEPLAY_GreyWolfPeltDescription.English: Freshly harvested fur from a Timberwolf. Warm, and striking to look at.
GAMEPLAY_GreyWolfPeltDescription.Spanish (Spain): Pelaje recién sacado de un lobo gris. Cálido, e impresionarte de ver.

GAMEPLAY_GreyWolfPeltDriedDescription.English: Fur from a Timberwolf. Warm, and striking to look at.
GAMEPLAY_GreyWolfPeltDriedDescription.Russian: Высушенная шкура лесного волка. Теплая, и выглядит прекрастно. Пригодиться для крафта и починки.
GAMEPLAY_GreyWolfPeltDriedDescription.Spanish (Spain): Pelaje de un lobo gris. Cálido, e impresionarte de ver.

GAMEPLAY_GreyWolfSkinCoatDescription.English: Handcrafted fur and skin outer layer will keep you warm and remind Timberwolves and Wolves alike that they should keep their distance. Not the way the Timberwolf expected to end up.
GAMEPLAY_GreyWolfSkinCoatDescription.Russian: Шуба ручной работы теплая и приятная на ощупь. Внешний слой полностью из меха. Такая шуба покажет волкам держаться на расстоянии. Думал ли волк, что у него будет такой конец.
GAMEPLAY_GreyWolfSkinCoatDescription.Spanish (Spain): La capa exterior hecha a mano con pelaje y piel te mantendrá caliente y le recordará tanto a lobos cómo lobos grises que deberían mantener las distancias. No es la forma en la que el lobo gris esperaba acabar.

GAMEPLAY_GreyWolfSkinBracesDescription.English: Made out of warm Timberwolf and durable Moose, these will protect your arms from danger, as well as providing you with some warmth.
GAMEPLAY_GreyWolfSkinBracesDescription.Russian: Наручни, сделанные из шкуры лесных волков и лося. Отлично защищают и согревают ваши руки.
GAMEPLAY_GreyWolfSkinBracesDescription.Spanish (Spain): Hecho con el calido pelaje del lobo gris y el resistente cuero del alce, protejeran tus brazos del peligro, además de proporcianarte algo de calor.

GAMEPLAY_BF_SaltBehaviourRotting.Spanish (Spain): No puedes salar carne que está pudriéndose.
GAMEPLAY_BF_SaltBehaviourRotting.German: Du kannst kein verdorbenes Fleisch salzen.
GAMEPLAY_BF_SaltBehaviourRotting.Russian: Вы не можете солить гниющее мясо.

GAMEPLAY_UndefinedChunkDescription.English: You're not supposed to see this.

GAMEPLAY_UndefinedOrcaLootDescription.English: You're not supposed to see this.

GAMEPLAY_UndefinedNestDescription.English: You're not supposed to see this.
